HPCL-IFpt-0000.title: HM120A-MS
HPCL-IFpt-0000.subTitle: Polypropylene
HPCL-IFpt-0000.description: HP Durapol® HM120A is a Polypropylene Homopolymer offering excellent processability, optimum cycle times, and superior surface aesthetics. It is ideally suited for manufacturing general-purpose injection moulded components, furniture, and houseware products.

specifications.property: Melt Flow Rate (@230°C/2.16 kg), gm/10 min
Tensile Strength at Yield, in MPa

HPCL-IFpt-0000.appData: HM120A is recommended for Injection Moulded products like Household articles, Caps & Closures, Furniture, Rigid Packaging and Compounding
packaging: 25 kg woven sack bags or FFS Bags

HPCL-IFpt-0001.title: HR033-MS
HPCL-IFpt-0001.subTitle: Polypropylene
HPCL-IFpt-0001.description: HP Durapol® HR033 is a Polypropylene Homopolymer specifically designed for tape extrusion applications. It offers excellent processability and outstanding mechanical properties, making it ideal for the manufacture of high-quality woven fabric and raffia products

specifications.property: Melt Flow Rate (230°C/2.16 kg), gm/10 min
Tensile Stress at Yield (23 °C, 50 mm/min), MPa

HPCL-IFpt-0001.appData: HR033 is recommended for Woven sacks for General Packaging, Cement, Food grains packaging, FIBC, Strapping, Ropes, yarns etc
packaging: 25 kg woven sack bags or FFS Bags

HPCL-IFpt-0002.title: F01019S-MS
HPCL-IFpt-0002.subTitle: Ployethylene
HPCL-IFpt-0002.description: HP Durapol® F01019S is a linear low-density polyethylene (LLDPE) general-purpose film grade designed for blown film applications. It contains slip and antiblock additives, providing excellent slip characteristics and good film openability.
HPCL-IFpt-0002.appData: Suitable for the manufacture of general-purpose films, industrial liners, garment bags, industrial packaging, and a wide range of flexible packaging applications.
HPCL-IFpt-0002.documentation: TDS of LL 1MI Slip grade F01019S

HPCL-IFpt-0003.title: F02020-MS
HPCL-IFpt-0003.subTitle: Ployethylene
HPCL-IFpt-0003.description: HP Durapol® F02020 is a butene-based Linear Low Density Polyethylene (LLDPE) general-purpose film grade developed for blown and cast film applications. The grade is supplied without slip and antiblock additives, providing flexibility for customized additive incorporation based on specific application requirements.

specifications.property: MFI of resin at 190 °C, 2.16 Kgs, g/10 min
(*)Data is typical value and is not intended for specification purpose. Values may change without any intimation. Film properties are on 25.4 micron thik film film with 2.5 BUR, Die gap

HPCL-IFpt-0003.appData: Stretch wrap films, air bubble films, liners, and other general-purpose blown film applications
HPCL-IFpt-0003.documentation: TDS of LL 2MI NonSlip grade F02020

HPCL-IFpt-0004.title: M50200-MS
HPCL-IFpt-0004.subTitle: Ployethylene
HPCL-IFpt-0004.description: HP Durapol® M50200 is a butene-based High Density Polyethylene (HDPE) grade designed for high-density injection moulding applications. It offers excellent dimensional stability, superior surface finish, and enhanced aesthetics, making it ideal for a wide range of injection-moulded products

specifications.property: Melt Flow Index @190°C, 2.16 kg, g/10 min
Tensile Strength at Yield, Type IV Specimen, MPa
Tensile Elongation at Break, Type IV Specimen, %

HPCL-IFpt-0004.appData: Household articles, thin-wall injection-moulded products, food containers, and other general-purpose injection-moulded applications
